target_method: Pose-specific common-scale atlas-derived reference landmarks; all waist tips registered to the rest root. Mid-lowering anchors interpolate coordinates of neighboring poses only, no appearance pixel interpolation. Human anchor review remains required.

tolerances.status: Provisional diagnostic thresholds; do not grant owner/visual acceptance
